PM Modi Congratulates Women's Cricket Team on Asian Games Gold

Last updated: 23 Sep 2026

S
Samjho Content Team
Finance and policy experts with 5+ years of experience helping Indians understand money, documents and government schemes.

Quick Summary

Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated India's Women's Cricket Team for winning the Gold medal at the Asian Games. He called it a splendid win for Indian cricket and praised the team's confidence, skill and teamwork. This is India's first Gold medal at this edition of the Games.

Why It Matters

What Happened Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi congratulated the Women's Cricket Team on winning the Gold medal at the Asian Games. He shared his message on X on September 22, 2026. The Prime Minister's Office posted the message from the PM's official handle. In his message, the PM said the team played with confidence, skill and wonderful teamwork. He also sent his best wishes to the whole squad. Why It Matters This win gives India its first Gold medal at this edition of the Asian Games. It is a big moment for Indian cricket and for every fan back home. The Prime Minister said the team has made the nation proud. The win can inspire many young cricketers across the country. If you are a young player, this shows what focus and teamwork can achieve on a world stage. Key Points - India's Women's Cricket Team won the Gold medal at the Asian Games. - Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the team on X. - This is India's first Gold at this edition of the Games. - The PM praised the team's confidence, skill and teamwork. - He wished the entire squad the very best.

Important Dates

  • The Prime Minister shared his congratulatory message on September 22, 2026.

FAQs

Who won the Gold medal at the Asian Games?

India's Women's Cricket Team won the Gold medal at the Asian Games.

Who congratulated the team?

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi congratulated the team.
